paite: Huan kei hon houpih angel ahong pai nawn a, mi ihmu lai phawn bang in ahong phawng hi.
heading: Khawnvak Koihna Muhna
english: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah, "Bang na mu a?" achi a. Ke'n, "Ngai in, dangka-eng khawnvak koihna, adawn a noubem leh apeng a khawnvak sagih omte, huai a khawnvak sagihte toh ka mu, chi in ka dawng hi.
english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps which are on the top of it;

paite: Huan Olive sing nih akiang a om, khat noubem taklam pang ah khat veilam pang ah," ka chi hi.
english: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”

paite: Huan ka dawng a, kei hon houpih angel kiang ah thu ka gen a, "Hiaite bang ahi ua, ka toupa?" ka chi hi.
english: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”

paite: Kei hon houpih angel in ahon dawng a, ka kiang ah, "Hiaite bang ahi ua na thei kei maw?" achi a. Ke'n, " 'Ii,' Thei lou, ka toupa," ka chi hi.
english: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

paite: Huaitak in ama'n hon dawng a, ka kiang ah thu agen a, "Hiai Zerubbabel kiang a TOUPA thu ahi: Thahatna in hilou, thilhihtheihna in leng hi sam lou, ka Kha in ahi zaw, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
heading: Zerubbabel Kiang A Pathian Thuchiam
english: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is Yahweh’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Kua na hia, Aw tang thupi? Zerubbabel ma ah mun zang na hong hi ding; ama'n atung ah, 'Hehpihna, hehpihna!' chi a kikou in suang poimohpen ahon lakhe ding hi," achi hi.
english: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”

paite: Huai lou in TOUPA thu ka kiang ahong tung lai a, hichi in achi:
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Zerubbabel khut in hiai inn suangphum akoih khinta; akhutte mah in azou ding, huan Sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang ah kei ahon sawlta chih na thei ding," chi in.
english: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that Yahweh of Armies has sent me to you.

paite: Thil neu kipat ni kua'n asimmoh thei a? Zerubbabel khut ah ulum amu ding ua, akipak ding uh. Hiai TOUPA mit sagihte ahi; leitung pumpi kantan a vialtaite.
english: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are Yahweh’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”

paite: Huan ke'n ka dawng a akiang ah, "Khawnvak koihna taklam pang tung a hiai olive sing nihte leh huai aveilam pang a bang ahi ua?" ka chi hi.
english: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”

paite: Anihveina ding in ka dong nawn a, akiang ah, "Dangka-eng kahiang nihte sik a om, dangka-eng sathau amau a kipan suah zel olive hiang nihte bang ahi ua?" ka chi hi.
english: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”

paite: Ama'n hon dawng a, hiaite bang hi ding ahi ua chih thei lou maw? achi a. Huan ke'n, " 'Ii,' Thei lou, ka toupa," ka chi hi.
english: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

paite: Huaitak in ama'n, "Hiaite leitung pumpi TOUPA kiang a dingh, thaunilh nihte ahi uh," achi hi.
english: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”
